title: session-snapshot-promote-with-heuristic-rollbacks
author: Aisha Karim
description:
Motivation: Provide a promotion controller that can take deterministic session-aligned snapshots of live traffic, execute a staged "promote" using those snapshots, and automatically apply heuristic rollback when session-level divergence or latency regressions are detected. This PR introduces a session snapshot store, snapshot-based promote operation, a lightweight heuristic rollback evaluator, and observability hooks.

What this enables: deterministic promotes for session-coherent workloads (e.g., chat, search-with-session-state), reproducible smoke replays against candidate models, and automated defensive rollbacks that act before user-visible degradation spreads.

Changes in this PR (high level):
- Session snapshot store and retention policy (in-memory+durable fallback).
- Promote controller that replays snapshots against candidate model(s) with configurable fidelity and traffic fractions.
- Heuristic rollback evaluator combining latency P50/P95 deltas, response token-length inflation, and semantic divergence score (fast approximate embedding distance).
- Safety gates: minimum sample size, graceful throttle, and holdpoint for manual review.
- Telemetry: per-snapshot metrics, promote-run traces, rollback reasons, and smoke-replay artifacts persisted for diagnostics.
- End-to-end tests and a new smoke-replay integration harness.

Risks and mitigations:
- Snapshot size growth: enforced retention TTLs and adaptive sampling (configurable).
- False positives in heuristics: tuned conservative thresholds and require multiple signals before auto-rollback.
- Backwards compatibility: controller operates as opt-in; no changes to default promote paths.

Testing and rollout plan:
- Unit and integration tests included.
- Dogfood rollout in a small internal workspace with synthetic session traffic for 48h.
- Beta release to Dedicated customers under feature flag for evaluation.

Checklist:
- [x] Session snapshot API and store implementation
- [x] Promote controller + replay runner
- [x] Heuristic rollback evaluator and configuration knobs
- [x] Telemetry events and dashboard patches
- [x] Integration tests and smoke harness
- [x] Docs for operator usage and safety playbook

Related: Linear ENG-9823 tracking the heuristic design; ENG-9845 for observability work. For incident tie-ins see SUP-341 (support ask for session-coherent promotes).

review_conversation: Liam Carter (reviewer): Can we make the semantic divergence estimator pluggable? Some teams need a more expensive exact compare.
Aisha Karim (author): Yes — added a DivergenceEstimator interface and a default fast-approx implementation; docs show how to register a heavy-weight estimator.
Maria Gomez (reviewer): What are safe defaults for auto-rollback thresholds? We should avoid noisy auto-rollbacks in low-volume cohorts.
Aisha Karim (author): Default is conservative (requires > 100 sessions and at least two signals over threshold). Added explicit config and noted it in the safety playbook.
Ethan Zhou (reviewer): The snapshot store fallback to objectstore needs a clear failure mode if objectstore is slow. Add a degrade-to-sampling mode.
Aisha Karim (author): Added degrade-to-sampling mode and a circuit-breaker metric; included a unit test that simulates objectstore latency spikes.
Liam Carter (approval): Approved with minor doc nitfix.
merge_summary: Squash-merged: session snapshot store + promote controller + heuristic rollback. Merged after CI green and approvals from 3 reviewers. Fixes Linear ENG-9823 and ENG-9845.
release_notes: Introduces an opt-in session snapshot promote flow with automated heuristic rollback. Operators can use the new feature flag to test promotes on session-coherent workloads; defaults are conservative to avoid unintended rollbacks.
